Name: AutoChestOrganizer Advanced Smart Storage
Author: KunYai00
Description:
📦 AutoChestOrganizer
Smart Storage Management for Stardew Valley
Designed for Mobile. Fully enjoyable on Desktop.
AutoChestOrganizer helps you organize, sort, and manage your storage automatically with minimal setup. Built with touch-screen gameplay in mind while remaining compatible with standard SMAPI desktop environments.
[line]
⭐ Why AutoChestOrganizer?
[heading]📱 Mobile-First Design[/heading]
Most storage mods were originally designed for keyboard and mouse.
AutoChestOrganizer was built with Android and touch-screen gameplay as a primary focus.
✔ Large touch-friendly buttons
✔ On-screen controls
✔ No keyboard required
✔ Tablet-friendly layouts
✔ Adjustable UI positioning
✔ Optimized for phones and tablets
[line]
[heading]🧠 Smart Chest Detection[/heading]
Simply open a chest.
The system can automatically:
• Analyze its contents
• Detect its primary purpose
• Assign a Smart Tag
• Rename the chest
• Configure sorting behavior
No manual naming.
No complicated setup.
Just play normally.
[line]
[heading]🎯 Minimal Setup Required[/heading]
Many storage mods require extensive configuration before they become useful.
AutoChestOrganizer is designed to work immediately.
Open a chest, play the game, and let the system handle the organization.
[line]
[heading]🛡️ Inventory Protection[/heading]
Automation should never put important items at risk.
Features include:
✔ Hotbar Protection
✔ Locked Chest Support
✔ Ignored Item Lists
✔ Safe Sorting Rules
Your tools, weapons, and essential items remain protected from automated actions.
[line]
[heading]⚡ Mobile Performance Aware[/heading]
Designed to reduce unnecessary background activity.
✔ Optional Low Power Mode
✔ Smart Scan Scheduling
✔ Reduced Background Processing
✔ Mobile-Friendly Automation
Ideal for Android devices and handheld gameplay.
[line]
🚀 Smart Automation Features
[heading]🔄 Smart Auto Sort[/heading]
Automatically organizes items using a weighted scoring system.
Priority:
Smart Tag Match → Item Match → Category Match
Items are routed to the most suitable destination whenever possible.
[line]
[heading]📦 Quick Dump[/heading]
Move matching items from your inventory into a chest with a single tap.
[line]
[heading]💰 Auto-Sell Storage[/heading]
Convert designated chests into automatic overnight shipping containers.
[line]
[heading]🏷️ Advanced Chest Filters[/heading]
Supports five filter modes:
• OFF
• WHITELIST
• BLACKLIST
• OVERFLOW
• AUTO-SELL
Create specialized storage networks with minimal effort.
[line]
🧠 Adaptive Storage System
AutoChestOrganizer can remember and adapt to your storage habits.
Repeated sorting decisions help the system better understand your preferred organization style over time.
The more you use it, the more consistent your storage becomes.
[line]
🛡️ Stability & Multiplayer
[heading]Anti-Loop Protection[/heading]
Prevents items from endlessly bouncing between automated chests.
[heading]Multiplayer Safe[/heading]
Built with multiplayer safeguards to help prevent duplication issues and synchronization problems.
[heading]Platform Support[/heading]
Officially tested:
✔ Windows (SMAPI)
✔ Android (SMAPI Mobile)
Expected to work on:
✔ Steam Deck
✔ Linux-based SMAPI environments
Compatibility may vary depending on device configuration and installed mods.
[line]
⚙️ Full GMCM Support
Configure nearly every aspect of the mod through Generic Mod Config Menu.
Customize:
• UI Layout
• Button Scale
• Touch Controls
• Automation Timers
• Sorting Behavior
• Performance Settings
• Language Options
Changes apply instantly without restarting the game.
[line]
📋 Requirements
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI 4.0+
• GMCM (Optional)
[line]
📌 Perfect For Players Who Want
✔ Automatic organization
✔ Mobile-friendly controls
✔ Minimal setup
✔ Safe inventory management
✔ Smart storage automation
✔ Better quality-of-life gameplay
Spend less time managing chests.
Spend more time enjoying Stardew Valley.
